cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You've spilled paint on my sofa. Stay there; I'll get a cloth. We can fix this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Keep blotting. You're doing well. That carpet was my birthday present.

beats.speaker: A
